data.long_meaning: From the Greek ortos (mountain) and penia (strength). This name symbolizes a woman of great fortitude and resilience, able to overcome adversity and rise above challenges. The name Ortensia carries the meaning “Mountain of strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ortensia usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
